messages:
sam_sales: Handing off Clinica Health to CS. Deal $95k ARR, Dedicated + Private VPC. PO: https://drive.redwood.com/clinica_po.pdf. Kickoff target 2028-06-01.
rachel_cs: Noted 1. Please drop signed PO + tech contacts + any BAA notes here.
sam_sales: PO linked above. Contacts: sara@clinica.health (tech lead), marco@clinica.health (procurement). Legal requested BAA.
tori_onboard: Quick Qs: will they ingest raw PHI or tokenized data? expected steady RPS? batch export cadence?
sam_sales: They'll send raw clinical notes for triage + embeddings for semantic search. Steady ~150 rps, pilot spikes to ~600 rps for ~72h. Monthly export ~50GB.
marco_support: Opening support ticket CS-3001 to track VPC peering, firewall rules, VPN endpoints. Need customer ASN and proposed CIDR.
dan_eng: From infra: need staging creds + anonymized sample to validate quality after quantization. Perf plan: perf-run --model clinical-v2 --n 500 --concurrency 8. If p95>140ms we'll test grpc batching & INT8 quant.
rachel_cs: Renewal risk: medium until 60-day window. Procurement asked for SLA guardrails and credits if error-rate >1.5% first 60 days.
tori_onboard: Proposed owners: rachel_cs (CS lead), tori_onboard (onboarding), marco_support (support triage), dan_eng (eng/perf), sam_sales (sales escalation). I'll create kickoff invite + onboarding runbook. Weekly status email for first 6 weeks owned by me.
marco_support: CS-3001 created: https://support.redwood.com/cs-3001. Attaching initial traceroute from customer shows intermittent packet loss; requesting VPN config. Pinging @oncall-network.
dan_eng: Will run perf within 48h of staging access and post raw/tuned numbers here. Need staging bucket for export tests and KMS key details.
rachel_cs: I'll author the CS playbook in Confluence and set 30/60/90-day checkpoints. Tags: PHI, latency-risk, renewal-sensitive.
jira-bot: CS-3001 transitioned to "In Progress" by marco_support.
sam_sales: Looping legal for BAA and security for KMS/customer-managed key docs. Procurement also asked for per-route cost forecast; I'll share pricing workbook.
rachel_cs: Thanks everyone. Next steps: tori to run kickoff (2028-06-01), marco to resolve CS-3001, dan to post perf results. I'll open a 30-day checkpoint thread after launch to surface metrics and escalations.
